scope: Nine parser/precedence/typed locale/atomic ownership cases per shell; isolated ignored paths only; no actual per-user settings written.

preliminary.status: superseded development smoke failures, not final gate results
preliminary.description: Initial C# String method shadow, generic Dictionary.Contains and File.Replace null-binding were corrected. A direct four-case File.Replace experiment (closed/held replacement, unpinned/pinned directory) passed only closed replacement cases. Even READ/WRITE/DELETE sharing on held data-access replacement failed; Microsoft ReplaceFileW opens replacement with no sharing. Root selected held SetFileInformationByHandle rename matching existing IO structure instead; both final hosts prove actual replacement, ownership denial and rollback.
preliminary.experiment_sketch_not_exact_execution_re: foreach($test in 1..4) { WriteAllText(old); WriteAllText(temp); if(test 2/4) hold temp FileStream(ReadWrite, ReadWrite|Delete); if(test 3/4) hold NativeFileIO.OpenDirectory; File.Replace(temp, old, NullString.Value); finally dispose all holds }

smokeScriptSource:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repository = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'))
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repository
. (Join-Path $repository 'WinAudioClean.ps1')
. (Join-Path $repository 'WinAudioClean.Settings.ps1')
$sourceHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repository 'WinAudioClean.Settings.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
$expectedHash = 'BB6C7F034FC65BFEAF26B769B09BA7D8535F98D5455AF68D72405B48B577F2DA'
if ($sourceHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw 'Smoke source changed.' }
Write-Output ('Host=' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion + '; helperSha256=' + $sourceHash)
$work = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ('helper-smoke-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
$path = Join-Path $work 'settings.json'
$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$passed = 0
$oldCulture = [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture
$oldUiCulture = [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture
function Assert-Smoke { param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message) if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message } }
try {
    $missing = Read-WacSettings -Path $path
    Assert-Smoke ($missing.Count -eq 0 -and -not [IO.Directory]::Exists($work)) 'Missing settings created a path.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS missing file is empty and does not create directories'
    $resolved = Resolve-WacSettings -Explicit @{ Mono = [Management.Automation.SwitchParameter]::new($false); CleaningOptions = @{}; inputPath = 'ignored.wav' } -Saved @{ Mode = 'Raw'; Mono = $true; BitDepth = '24'; CleaningOptions = @{ Gate = $false } }
    Assert-Smoke ($resolved.Values.Mono -is [bool] -and -not $resolved.Values.Mono -and $resolved.Values.CleaningOptions.Count -eq 0 -and $resolved.Origins.Mono -eq 'CLI' -and $resolved.Origins.Mode -eq 'Saved') 'Precedence failed.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS explicit false and empty cleaning dictionary replace saved preferences'
    foreach ($culture in @('de-DE', 'fi-FI')) {
        [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = [Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($culture)
        [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = [Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($culture)
        $values = @{ Mode = 'Raw'; Preset = 'Gentle'; BitDepth = '24'; Mono = $false; AudioStreamIndex = '0'; CleaningOptions = @{ NoiseReductionDb = 4.5 } }
        $null = Save-WacSettings -Path $path -Values $values
        $read = Read-WacSettings -Path $path
        Assert-Smoke ($read.BitDepth -ceq '24' -and $read.AudioStreamIndex -ceq '0' -and $read.CleaningOptions.NoiseReductionDb -eq 4.5 -and $read.Mono -is [bool]) 'Roundtrip lost settings types.'
        Assert-Smoke ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($path).Contains('4.5')) 'Locale changed JSON decimal serialization.'
        $passed++; Write-Output ('PASS atomic save/read typed decimal roundtrip ' + $culture)
    }
    $rejected = $false
    try { $null = Resolve-WacSettings -Explicit @{ Mode = 'Raw' } -Saved @{ Mode = 'Zoom'; Preset = 'Gentle' } } catch { $rejected = $true }
    Assert-Smoke $rejected 'Saved invalid profile escaped validation.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS whole saved profile validates before CLI override'
    $bad = Join-Path $work 'bad.json'
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($bad, '{"schemaVersion":1,"settings":{"mode":"Raw","mo\u0064e":"Zoom"}}', $utf8)
    $rejected = $false
    try { $null = Read-WacSettings -Path $bad } catch { $rejected = $true }
    Assert-Smoke $rejected 'Escaped duplicate key was accepted.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS duplicate decoded JSON keys reject'
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($bad, [byte[]]@(0x7b, 0xff, 0x7d))
    $rejected = $false
    try { $null = Read-WacSettings -Path $bad } catch { $rejected = $true }
    Assert-Smoke $rejected 'Malformed UTF-8 was accepted.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS malformed UTF-8 rejects'
    $before = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path)
    $originalPublisher = (Get-Command Publish-WacSettingsFile).ScriptBlock
    $script:DeleteDenied = $false; $script:RenameDenied = $false; $script:WriteDenied = $false
    function Publish-WacSettingsFile {
        param($TempPath, $Path, $DestinationExists, $Writer, $Directory)
        try { [IO.File]::Delete($TempPath) } catch [IO.IOException] { $script:DeleteDenied = $true }
        try { [IO.File]::Move($TempPath, ($TempPath + '.foreign')) } catch [IO.IOException] { $script:RenameDenied = $true }
        $foreignWriter = $null
        try { $foreignWriter = [IO.FileStream]::new($TempPath, [IO.FileMode]::Open, [IO.FileAccess]::Write, [IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite -bor [IO.FileShare]::Delete) }
        catch [IO.IOException] { $script:WriteDenied = $true }
        finally { if ($null -ne $foreignWriter) { $foreignWriter.Dispose() } }
        throw [OperationCanceledException]::new('Injected publication interruption.')
    }
    $rejected = $false
    try { $null = Save-WacSettings -Path $path -Values @{} } catch { $rejected = $true }
    finally { Set-Item -LiteralPath Function:\Publish-WacSettingsFile -Value $originalPublisher }
    Assert-Smoke ($rejected -and $script:DeleteDenied -and $script:RenameDenied -and $script:WriteDenied) 'Foreign operations were not denied.'
    Assert-Smoke ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($path) -ceq $before) 'Interrupted save changed prior bytes.'
    Assert-Smoke (@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $work -Filter '.wac-settings-*.tmp').Count -eq 0) 'Interrupted save leaked its owned temp.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS interrupted publish preserves prior bytes, denies foreign temp writes/rename/delete, and cleans owned temp'
    $null = Save-WacSettings -Path $path -Values @{}
    Assert-Smoke ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($path) -ceq '{"schemaVersion":1,"settings":{}}') 'Reset did not save empty versioned settings.'
    Assert-Smoke ((Read-WacSettings -Path $path).Count -eq 0) 'Reset read is not empty.'
    $passed++; Write-Output 'PASS atomic reset writes valid empty settings'
    Write-Output ('RESULT passed=' + $passed + '; failed=0')
} finally {
    [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = $oldCulture
    [Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = $oldUiCulture
}
